worker_claims.summary: Implemented W-4: a tier A build-time check that every web/app/api route holding a service-role Supabase client resolves a principal or sits on a reviewed, reasoned exception list. The check is an AST walk over TypeScript's own parser, credited binding-by-binding to one structurally-defined terminal primitive (.auth.getUser/getClaims/getSession), deliberately unlike auditAuthorityPaths.mjs which over-reported ~30x via file-level regex. Wrappers are discovered by the walk, not hand-listed. Wired into prebuild; exits 1 on any unlisted route or stale list entry. Recorded the measured exception baseline as evidence and wrote the execution record into the plan of record. No route handler, schema, migration or UI was changed; remediation is W-15 by scope.
